name: autogpt

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: OpenAI API key. AutoGPT's classic loop assumes GPT-4-class function-calling.

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.description: Anthropic API key for Claude-backed agents.

AUTOGPT_WORKSPACE.description: Workspace directory the agent can read/write. Defaults to ./.autogpt-workspace.

AUTOGPT_BUDGET_USD.description: Hard cost ceiling per run, in USD. Loop terminates when exceeded. Defaults to 5.

notes: Autonomous goal-pursuit loop — plans, executes, reflects, repeats. MONITOR tier with a high trust floor; cost ceiling is enforced via AUTOGPT_BUDGET_USD because the failure mode (recursive planning loops) directly burns API spend. License is custom — review upstream LICENSE before commercial use.
